metadata.name: People using safely managed drinking water services, urban (% of urban population)
metadata.sourceNote: The percentage of people using drinking water from an improved source that is accessible on premises, available when needed and free from fecal and priority chemical contamination. Improved water sources include piped water, boreholes or tubewells, protected dug wells, protected springs, and packaged or delivered water.

method: 都市人口・農村人口をそれぞれ分母とする安全管理飲料水の利用率。全国系列と同じWDI更新日・JMP公表版。都市−農村の差は同じ年の両方が有効な場合のみ算出（ポイント）。欠測を補間・ゼロ置換せず、全国率を都市・農村率の単純平均から作らない。
